clips.title: The story
paras: Keeper Albagorm is a keeper of the grove stationed at the idyllic sanctuary of Stonetalon Peak. Deeply concerned by the devastation corrupting the southern reaches of the mountains, he enlists travelers to help heal the scorched wilderness of the Charred Vale.

Perched within the peaceful boughs of Stonetalon Peak, Keeper Albagorm stands vigil over one of Kalimdor's sacred elven refuges. Like many sons of Cenarius, he feels the pain of the natural world acutely. His attention is drawn southward toward the smoldering ruins of the Charred Vale, set afire by a greedy mechanized army of industrialists and now held by Bloodfury harpies who block any regrowth. From his sanctuary, Albagorm works tirelessly to halt the spread of the corruption and restore balance to the wounded forest.
